gh pr create --title "feat: #10 - Add dark mode to the application" --body "$(cat <<'EOF'
## Summary

This PR implements dark mode functionality for the Finkargo Automation Hub, addressing issue #10. Users can now toggle between light and dark themes from the user menu in the top right corner.

## Implementation Plan

See [specs/20251123_dark_mode_implementation.md](specs/20251123_dark_mode_implementation.md) for detailed implementation specifications.

## Changes

### Core Theme System
- ✅ Created `ThemeContext.tsx` - Global theme state management with localStorage persistence
- ✅ Created `useThemeMode.ts` - Custom hook for theme mode access
- ✅ Created `darkTheme.ts` - Complete dark mode theme following Finkargo design system
- ✅ Created `types/theme.ts` - TypeScript definitions for theme modes

### Theme Implementation
- ✅ Updated `theme.ts` - Refactored to support both light and dark modes with proper color palette
- ✅ Dark theme includes:
  - Primary colors with proper contrast ratios
  - Dark backgrounds (#121212, #1E1E1E)
  - Adjusted component styles (cards, buttons, inputs)
  - Enhanced shadows and borders for dark mode
  - Consistent spacing and typography

### UI Integration
- ✅ Updated `App.tsx` - Integrated ThemeContext provider
- ✅ Updated `FKUserMenu.tsx` - Added theme toggle with Brightness4/Brightness7 icons
- ✅ Theme preference persists across sessions via localStorage

### Key Features
- Theme toggle in user menu (top right corner)
- Smooth theme transitions
- Persistent theme preference
- WCAG AA compliant contrast ratios
- Finkargo brand colors maintained in both modes

## Testing Checklist

- [x] Theme toggle appears in user menu
- [x] Theme switches correctly between light and dark
- [x] Theme preference persists after page reload
- [x] All components render correctly in both themes
- [x] Text contrast meets accessibility standards
- [x] No console errors or warnings

## ADW Tracking

Closes #10
